board: Adafruit Mini GPS PA1010D - UART and I2C - STEMMA QT (product 4415)
reason: Modelled as a uart-device NMEA stream (GGA+RMC, 9600 baud 8N1, ddmm.mmmm per the CD-PA1010D datasheet) with a checksum-verifying driver that accepts any talker (GN default) and sends PMTK commands; 12 pins from both 6-pin headers in board order (cabled), and the check passed on ESP32 and Pico.
